description: Bridges in a state that are load-posted or closed to traffic (NBI Item 41 status P/R/K), worst condition first. Relevant for routing and heavy-haul feasibility, but per FHWA, NBI data must not be used as the sole source for route clearance; inspections can be up to ~24 months old. Read-only; no API key. limit defaults to 100 (max 1000); offset defaults to 0. Use get_worst_bridges instead for Poor-condition bridges regardless of posting status, and search_bridges instead for a narrower filter set.

offset.description: Results to skip for paging, default 0

name: list_posted_or_closed_bridges
